_note: Medicaid-funded in-home personal care programs, by state. VA Aid & Attendance and long-term care insurance are handled separately in pipeline.py because they're federal/private and don't vary by state. PACE is handled separately via pace_areas in reference.json. Sourced: CA/TX/FL/NY/IL/PA researched directly (state agency sites); all other states fall back to '_default' until mapped. Eligibility gates are simplified generalizations, not verbatim program rules -- verify against the state's current rules before relying on this for a real applicant.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: IHSS (In-Home Supportive Services)
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On Medi-Cal and needs help with {needs}.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Apply with {county} County IHSS. A family member can enroll as the paid caregiver.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: Medi-Cal MSSP care management
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: Age 65+ on Medi-Cal with high care needs.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Ask the {county} County Area Agency on Aging for an MSSP screening.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: STAR+PLUS HCBS (Personal Assistance Services)
medicaid_home_care_programs.administering_agency: Texas HHSC, delivered via a Medicaid managed-care organization (MCO)
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On Medicaid and needs help with {needs}.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Contact your STAR+PLUS managed-care plan to request a Personal Assistance Services (PAS) assessment.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: Statewide Medicaid Managed Care – Long-Term Care (SMMC-LTC)
medicaid_home_care_programs.administering_agency: Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), delivered via a managed-care plan
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On Medicaid with high care needs; nursing-home level of care confirmed via a CARES assessment.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Request a CARES assessment through your local Aging and Disability Resource Center, then enroll in an SMMC-LTC plan.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: CDPAP (Consumer Directed Personal Assistance Program)
medicaid_home_care_programs.administering_agency: NYS Dept of Health, via a statewide fiscal intermediary
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On NY Medicaid and needs help with {needs}.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Enroll through the state's fiscal intermediary (Public Partnerships LLC) to hire a family member or chosen caregiver.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: Community Care Program (CCP)
medicaid_home_care_programs.administering_agency: Illinois Department on Aging, via regional Area Agencies on Aging
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: Age 60+ on Medicaid and needs help with {needs}.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Contact your regional Care Coordination Unit for a Determination of Need screening.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: Community HealthChoices (CHC)
medicaid_home_care_programs.administering_agency: PA Dept of Human Services, delivered via a managed-care organization
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On Medicaid with high care needs (assistance with multiple daily activities).
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Contact the Independent Enrollment Broker to enroll in a Community HealthChoices plan.

medicaid_home_care_programs.name: State Medicaid Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS)
medicaid_home_care_programs.why_template: On Medicaid and needs help with {needs}; this state's specific program isn't individually mapped yet.
medicaid_home_care_programs.apply_step: Contact your state Medicaid office to ask about Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) waivers or Community First Choice (1915(k)).
